name: Lake Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Lake Materials Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures organometallic compounds that are used as materials for semiconductors, displays, solar applications, in South Korea. The company offers electronic materials for various semiconductors, displays, and LEDs; metallocene compound; and catalysts for petrochemical industries. Its products include trimethylgallium, trimethylaluminum, and trimethylindium; and fine chemical materials, metallocene catalysts, co-catalysts, supported catalysts, etc. used in the petrochemical field.
